final:
I changed cookie listing and cookie sending to follow the RFC 6265 domain and path rules. I haven't built or run anything, so none of it is tested.

- **Path match (`cookieStore.ts`):** `pathMatches` no longer appends a slash to the request path. It now matches only when the paths are equal, or when the cookie path is a prefix of the request path and either ends in `/` or is followed by `/`. So `/foo/` no longer matches `/foo`, and `/api` no longer matches `/apiv2`. I exported it.
- **Cookie listing (`network.ts`):** `filterCookies` now calls `domainMatches` and `pathMatches` from `cookieStore.ts` instead of its own checks. It no longer puts a dot in front of every cookie domain, so a host-only cookie for `example.com` doesn't match `sub.example.com`. This function is shared by the API request context and the Chromium, Firefox, WebKit and BiDi browser contexts, so the fix covers all of them.

`network.ts` now imports from `cookieStore.ts`, which already imports `isLocalHostname` from `network.ts`. The imported functions are only called at runtime, not at load time, so I expect the circular import to be harmless.
